item.title: Investigation continues into Nvidia CEO's alleged relationship with Chinese spy
item.description: Fallout continues at the chip giant Nvidia. Its powerful CEO is accused of having an affair with a Chinese spy.

item.title: Why a South Korean city is turning to a U.S. college to outsmart AI?
item.description: Through civic participation and liberal education, South Korean educators hope to "quietly stitch the fabric of our democracy…before it unravels beyond repair."

item.title: Palantir hires a former Democratic senator as it faces scrutiny in new Congress
item.description: The secretive software company has been accused of letting its powerful tools be used by the Trump administration to surveil Americans. Now it's hiring former Sen. Jon Tester to burnish its image.

item.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's alleged relationship with Chinese spy
item.description: Chipmaker Nvidia is launching an investigation of its CEO Jensen Huang after news reports he had an affair with a Chinese woman who was recruited to spy for Beijing.

item.title: Google, Meta and TikTok sue to block California youth social media law
item.description: Google, Meta, and TikTok have sued California to block the enforcement of a state law meant to protect children from getting addicted to social media.

item.title: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland
item.description: Thousands across the U.S. have gotten involved to oppose data centers. One is a Maryland woman who'd been evicted after a pay cut and became a leader of a community effort that blocked a vast project.

item.title: Review: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is superb, streamlined and safe
item.description: Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake enshrines its place in the gaming canon for generations to come. But despite its stupendous production values, the game left me feeling oddly bereft.
